name: witness_tiers

pipeline.tier_reason: the census reads the tier of every claim in the store and fails on one without: exhaustive over the store

statement: Every claim carries its tier: a finite witness sized by the class both forms fall in (a polynomial, a C-finite sequence of one counted loop, regions cut by guards) proves equality; everything else is labelled a sample.
usefulness: A test that only samples says so, and where a theorem makes a few points enough, those points are a proof.
